description.short_caption: Forearm with necrotic ulcers and surrounding erythema.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a forearm with multiple necrotic ulcers of varying sizes. The largest lesion has a dark, necrotic center with surrounding erythema. Smaller lesions with crusted surfaces are also visible. The skin appears pale with some areas of discoloration. The background is a clinical setting with a white cloth beneath the arm.

description.short_caption: Calcofluor white stain showing fluorescent fungal elements.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a fluorescent microscopic view of fungal elements stained with Calcofluor white. The fungal structures appear as bright green, branching, filamentous forms against a dark background. The stain highlights chitin in the fungal cell walls, aiding in the identification of fungal organisms. The image is consistent with the use of fluorescence microscopy.

This image shows a fluorescent microscopic view of fungal hyphae stained with Calcofluor white. The stain binds to chitin in fungal cell walls, causing the hyphae to fluoresce brightly under ultraviolet or blue light. The branching structure of the hyphae is clearly visible against the dark background, characteristic of fungal morphology.

description.short_caption: Lactophenol cotton blue stain showing fungal hyphae.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a microscopic view of fungal elements stained with lactophenol cotton blue. The fungal hyphae are long, filamentous, and septate, with occasional branching. The stain highlights the structures in blue against a light background, aiding in visualization of the fungal morphology. No specific anatomical site is indicated as this is a laboratory preparation.
